product_name: Liberty Flexible Investment Plan (Investment Plan and Investment Plan with Income)

about.investment_plan: A single premium life policy where policy benefits are determined by reference to underlying assets held by the insurer. Minimum term of 5 years; allows exposure to more than one investment portfolio; provides a facility to phase in initial and ad hoc considerations via a money market portfolio. Aimed at high-income investors with sophisticated investment market knowledge who want ownership of investment decision-making.
about.investment_plan_with_income: A single premium life policy consisting of two portions: (1) the Investment Plan portion, operating the same as the Investment Plan, and (2) a Guaranteed Income Annuity portion - a fixed-interest annuity paid monthly, with income that can be level or escalate in the first 5 years, at the maximum level or any selected level below maximum.

eligibility.investment_plan: Available to individuals, companies, trusts, and untaxed entities. Only a natural person can be the life assured.
eligibility.investment_plan_with_income: Only available to individuals. Only a natural person can be the life assured.

additional_premiums.restriction: Ad hoc premium is limited such that total premiums in any policy year do not exceed 120% of the greater of premiums paid in the previous two years (to avoid triggering a new 5-year restriction period).
additional_premiums.annuity_note: No ad hoc premiums allowed on the Guaranteed Income Annuity portion.

features: Set for a period of five years from inception or until death of the life assured.
Liberty guarantees annuity payments for the term.
Can be level or escalating at a set percentage over the 5-year period, selected by the investor.
Interest on the annuity is taxed at the investor's marginal tax rate; capital content of each payment is tax-free.
Paid monthly in arrears on the date the money was loaded (no other frequency available).

death_benefit.investment_plan: Greater of: (1) Initial consideration less advances/advisory fees/charges, and (2) value of the investment account at date of death.
death_benefit.investment_plan_with_income: Commuted value of outstanding income payments plus the greater of: (1) Investment Plan Initial Consideration less withdrawals/advisory fees, and (2) value of the Investment account at date of death.
death_benefit.no_beneficiaries_nominated: Paid to policyholder or policyholder's estate.
death_benefit.ceded_policy: Death benefits payable to the cessionary.

initial_advisory_fee.range: 0% to 5% (limited for some distribution channels) of Initial Consideration
initial_advisory_fee.deducted_from: Initial Consideration invested; also applies to ad hoc investment amounts.

fees.ongoing_commission_note: Recovery fee deducted monthly from investment account for 5 years; payable to intermediary; investor can cancel at any time.
fees.annuity_commission: Maximum 1.5% of premium for Guaranteed Income Annuity (Investment Plan with Income).
fees.management_fee: 1.92% p.a. of investment value (Investment Plan / Investment Plan portion).
fees.foreign_currency_fee: Additional 0.48% p.a. management fee on specified offshore portfolios (e.g. Excelsior Global range, Liberty Offshore range, STANLIB Global funds).
fees.policy_fee: Not applicable for Investment Plan; R18 per annuity payment for Investment Plan with Income.

early_termination_charge.applies_when: Advance or surrender taken in first 5 years.
early_termination_charge.schedule_summary: Starts at 4.00% in month 1, reducing progressively to 0.00% by month 49 onwards.

options: Capital (protects investment value against negative returns)
Capital Plus (secures initial consideration plus an additional agreed minimum return)
guarantees.guarantee_date: 5th policy anniversary, applies if invested for the full 5 years.
cancellation_triggers: Advisory fees taken after first option date

surrenders_advances.legislative_limit: One loan (advance) and one withdrawal (full surrender) permitted during first 5 years; sum may not exceed premium plus 5% p.a. compound interest.

advances.year_2_to_5: One advance allowed, restricted to max 90% of investment value less charges, less any previous advance.
advances.after_5_years: Unlimited advances subject to Section 54 (20% rule) restrictions.

full_surrenders.restriction: Max 90% of investment value less charges, less any previous advance.

surrenders_advances.annuity_portion: Surrender value is future payments discounted at prevailing risk discount rate; Investment Plan and annuity portions cannot be surrendered independently.

ownership.investment_plan: Individuals, trusts, and companies allowed. Security and outright cessions available.
ownership.investment_plan_with_income: Only individuals allowed. Absolute cessions not allowed (collateral cessions allowed); absolute cession possible after initial 5 years.

policy_term: Initial policy term is 5 years; open-ended thereafter.
